title: Part 4 — Talk 1: store announcement
instructionsVi: Bài nói một chiều, không có ai hỏi lại nên mọi thông tin chỉ xuất hiện một lần. Ba câu theo thứ tự đầu, giữa, cuối bài.
promptEn: Listen to the announcement and answer questions 71 through 73.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Attention shoppers. The store will be closing in thirty minutes, at eight o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Please note that the customer service desk closes fifteen minutes earlier than the store, so if you need a return or an exchange, please make your way there now.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: A reminder that our sale on winter clothing continues until Sunday, with a further ten per cent off already reduced items when you use a loyalty card.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Finally, the lift to the car park is out of service this evening. The stairs at the north end of the building remain open, and staff are available at the exit if you need assistance. Thank you for shopping with us.

questions.prompt: 71. When does the customer service desk close?
questions.explanationVi: Cửa hàng đóng lúc 8 giờ, quầy dịch vụ đóng 'fifteen minutes earlier' — tức 7:45. Phải tự tính, con số không được đọc ra.

questions.prompt: 72. What is required for the extra discount?
questions.explanationVi: 'a further ten per cent off already reduced items when you use a loyalty card'.

options.text: The lift is out of service.

questions.explanationVi: 'the lift to the car park is out of service this evening'. Cầu thang được nói rõ là VẪN mở, nên (C) sai.

title: Part 4 — Talk 2: voicemail from a dentist
instructionsVi: Tin nhắn thoại. Dạng này gần như luôn có một yêu cầu hành động ở cuối và ít nhất một thông tin bị sửa lại giữa chừng.
promptEn: Listen to the telephone message and answer questions 74 through 76.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Good morning, this is Sandra calling from Fairview Dental Practice for Mr Adeyemi.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I'm calling about your appointment with Dr Lin, which was booked for Thursday the ninth at four fifteen.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Unfortunately Dr Lin is now attending a training course that week. We can offer you the same time on Thursday the sixteenth, or an earlier slot on Tuesday the seventh at nine in the morning.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Please call us back on 0161 447 2290 to let us know which you prefer. If we don't hear from you by Friday, we'll release the slot to someone on the waiting list.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: One other thing — please remember to bring the list of medication we asked for last time. Thank you.

questions.prompt: 74. Why is the appointment being changed?

options.text: The patient asked to move it.
The practice is closed that week.
The dentist will be on a training course.

questions.explanationVi: 'Dr Lin is now attending a training course that week'.

questions.prompt: 75. What happens if the patient does not reply by Friday?

options.text: The slot will be offered to someone else.

questions.explanationVi: 'we'll release the slot to someone on the waiting list'.

questions.prompt: 76. What is the patient reminded to bring?
questions.explanationVi: 'please remember to bring the list of medication we asked for last time'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 3: radio traffic report
instructionsVi: Bản tin giao thông. Nhiều địa danh và con số nối nhau rất nhanh; ghi nhanh trong lúc nghe thay vì cố nhớ.
promptEn: Listen to the traffic report and answer questions 77 through 79.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: And now the travel news at half past eight.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: There are long delays on the eastbound A40 following an earlier collision near junction twelve. Two lanes are now open, but traffic is queuing back around four miles.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: Drivers heading into the city are advised to leave at junction ten and follow the ring road instead. That adds about fifteen minutes but avoids the queue entirely.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: On the railways, services between Central and Hartwell are running normally again after yesterday's signal failure.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: And a reminder that the Bridge Street car park is closed all week for resurfacing. The nearest alternative is the multi-storey on Ellis Road.

questions.prompt: 77. What has caused the delays on the A40?
questions.explanationVi: 'following an earlier collision near junction twelve'. Signal failure là chuyện của đường sắt — bẫy ghép sai nguyên nhân.

questions.prompt: 78. What are drivers advised to do?

options.text: Leave at junction ten and use the ring road

questions.explanationVi: 'leave at junction ten and follow the ring road instead'. Junction 12 là nơi xảy ra tai nạn.

questions.prompt: 79. What is said about the Bridge Street car park?

options.text: It closes at half past eight.

questions.explanationVi: 'the Bridge Street car park is closed all week for resurfacing'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 4: introducing a speaker
instructionsVi: Bài giới thiệu diễn giả. Câu hỏi thường hỏi nghề nghiệp, thành tựu, và việc sẽ diễn ra ngay sau đó.
promptEn: Listen to the introduction and answer questions 80 through 82.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Good evening and welcome to the Riverside Business Forum.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: It's my pleasure to introduce tonight's speaker, Dr Amara Sesay. Dr Sesay spent twelve years in logistics before moving into research, and she now leads the supply chain group at Northfield University.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Her book on resilience after disruption was published last spring and has since been translated into six languages.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: She'll be speaking for about forty minutes, and we'll then take questions for a further twenty. If you'd like to ask something, there are cards on each table — write your question down and a steward will collect them during the talk.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Please join me in welcoming Dr Sesay.

questions.prompt: 80. What did the speaker do before entering research?
questions.explanationVi: 'Dr Sesay spent twelve years in logistics before moving into research'.

questions.prompt: 81. What is said about her book?

options.text: It will be published next spring.
It is available at the entrance.
It has been translated into six languages.

questions.explanationVi: 'published last spring and has since been translated into six languages'. Chú ý 'last', không phải 'next'.

questions.prompt: 82. How should the audience ask questions?

options.text: By writing them on cards during the talk
By raising their hands after the talk
By speaking to a steward at the end

questions.explanationVi: 'write your question down and a steward will collect them during the talk'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 5: automated telephone message
instructionsVi: Tin nhắn tự động của tổng đài. Nhiều lựa chọn bấm phím nối nhau; câu hỏi hỏi phải bấm số nào cho tình huống cụ thể.
promptEn: Listen to the recorded message and answer questions 83 through 85.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Halcyon Insurance. Please listen carefully as our options have changed.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: To make a new claim, press one. To check the status of an existing claim, press two. For renewals and changes to your policy, press three.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: If you are calling about a payment that has failed, please do not press any of these options — stay on the line and you will be connected directly to our accounts team.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Please note that our offices are closed on public holidays, and that calls are recorded for training purposes.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: You can also manage most policy changes yourself through the customer portal on our website, which is available at any time.

questions.prompt: 83. What should a caller do about a failed payment?

options.text: Call back after a public holiday

questions.explanationVi: 'please do not press any of these options — stay on the line'. Câu phủ định ngay trước là chỗ quyết định.

questions.prompt: 84. Which option is for changing a policy?
questions.explanationVi: 'For renewals and changes to your policy, press three'.

questions.prompt: 85. What alternative does the message suggest?
questions.explanationVi: 'manage most policy changes yourself through the customer portal on our website'.
